title: WHAT_IS_REAL
universal_lens: The system is a constrained dynamical manifold where agent authority and workflow transitions are strictly bounded by boolean gates. Real logic execution forms a measure-preserving subspace, isolating deterministic state evolutions from stochastic or unverified external perturbations.
gsi_mapping: Identity resolvers enforce strict Bayesian priors over player-game mappings, rejecting name-only merges to prevent posterior collapse. Stat coverage auditors act as conformal predictors, flagging distributional gaps in historical data that require explicit human review before updating the likelihood model.
gse_mapping: Task routing operates as a Markov Decision Process with hard fail-closed transition constraints. The operating map defines a directed acyclic graph of situational states, ensuring projection weights only update via approved, settled-historical trajectories without lookahead bias.

primitives.name: Agent Authority & External Action Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Honest per-agent status; `externalActionsAllowed:false` for all; forbidden-action list on all.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: A: Agent set (dimensionless), E_a: External action allowance (Boolean), F_a: Forbidden action set (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: All agents operate within a closed sandbox unless explicitly granted root privileges; default security posture is zero-trust.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if any agent's `externalActionsAllowed` evaluates to true, breaking the isolated operational boundary.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSE's situational constraint layer, preventing unauthorized state mutations during live game clock progression.
layer2.telemetry: Audit logs verifying zero successful external actions from sandboxed agents.

primitives.name: Operational Capacity Summation
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Agent health** — `agent-health.ts` `summarizeAgentHealth()`; `operationalCapacity = 0` (only REAL|PARTIAL counted); notWired/draftOnly/manual tracked separately.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_op: Operational capacity (scalar count), S_i: Status of agent i (Enum: REAL, PARTIAL, DRAFT)
primitives.assumptions: Only fully wired or partially functional agents contribute to the active computational mass; draft states are mathematically zero-weighted.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System failure if C_op drops below the minimum quorum required to execute critical path workflows.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's active sensor network availability, dynamically scaling inference confidence based on live data feed integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time dashboard rendering of `operationalCapacity` versus total registered agents.

primitives.name: GSIS-Only Identity Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **NFL identity resolvers** — `nfl/player-identity-resolver.ts` (GSIS-only; no name-only merge), `team-resolver.ts`, `game-resolver.ts` (no commence-time-only join), `season-week.ts` (`isSettledHistoricalSeason`).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: ID_gsis: Global Sports Identifier (UUID), T_commence: Commence time (ISO 8601), M_name: Name match score (Float)
primitives.assumptions: Fuzzy matching on names or timestamps alone introduces unacceptable collision probabilities; strict primary key alignment is mandatory.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Data corruption regime if fallback to name-only merging is enabled, causing entity duplication in the feature registry.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to GSI's foundational entity graph, ensuring unique node identification across disparate data ingestion pipelines.
layer2.telemetry: Collision rate metrics showing zero false-positive merges across historical season datasets.

reasoning_traces.think:
The architecture delineates a rigorous separation between 'real' executable logic and typed-but-unwired scaffolding. Mathematically, this establishes a partitioned state space \Omega = \Omega_{real} \cup \Omega_{draft}. The primitive operators—specifically the agent authority gates and task routers—act as projection matrices P that annihilate any vector originating from \Omega_{draft}, ensuring the system dynamics are entirely governed by the verified subspace. The `operationalCapacity` metric serves as the trace of this projection matrix, quantifying the dimensionality of the active control surface. By enforcing `externalActionsAllowed:false`, the system imposes a Dirichlet boundary condition on the agent manifold, preventing information leakage or unauthorized state mutations from the external environment. The identity resolvers further refine this by applying strict equivalence relations ~ on the entity space, rejecting probabilistic matches (like name collisions) in favor of deterministic GSIS alignments. This ensures that the feature registry, which feeds into the projection models, remains free of topological defects caused by entity duplication. The workflow gates, returning literal `false` for weight changes, introduce a temporal freezing mechanism, locking the model parameters until a `claudeReviewRequired` event triggers a controlled phase transition. Thus, the entire runtime can be viewed as a constrained optimization problem where the objective function (accurate sports intelligence) is maximized subject to hard logical constraints enforced by the TypeScript type system and explicit boolean gates.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from formal methods in distributed systems, specifically the principle of fail-closed safety mechanisms seen in nuclear control rods. It echoes the development of capability-based security (CBSD) in early operating systems, where objects explicitly grant rights rather than relying on implicit permissions. In quantitative finance, it mirrors the strict segregation of trade execution engines from market data parsers to prevent fat-finger errors, ensuring that only validated, settled data influences pricing models.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models opposing decision actors—namely, the automated agents versus the external market or human overseers—as adversarial entities attempting to inject noise or unauthorized commands. By assuming all external inputs are hostile or malformed, the `forbidden-action` lists act as a cognitive firewall. The agents anticipate attempts to bypass the GSIS resolver using fuzzy string matching, preemptively blocking such paths to maintain data purity. This defensive modeling ensures that the projection features remain robust against spoofing or data poisoning attacks from upstream APIs.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced through the strict decoupling of the in-memory runtime and the database persistence layer. Although DB writes currently no-op, the veto condition lies in the `workflow-gates.ts`, which explicitly forbids publishing or changing model weights without explicit human approval. This prevents the leakage of unverified, high-frequency noise from the raw stat coverage auditor directly into the long-term projection models. If a stat gap is detected, the `claudeReviewRequired` flag acts as a cross-layer circuit breaker, halting the automatic propagation of incomplete data vectors into the final inference engine.
